name: Mooli Moong Dal
ingredients: ½ cup dry yellow moong dal
Ginger, jeera, hing, turmeric and 1 tsp oil
steps: Add a light ginger-jeera tempering; finish with lemon.
note: A lighter lentil meal with vegetables and fibre.
